task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the report creation screen showing 'Active Cases by Priority' in the Name field and 'Cases' selected in the Report Module dropdown.

task_completion.description: Include columns for Number, Subject, Priority, and Status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Fields' tab or section showing 'Number' (case_number), 'Subject' (name), 'Priority', and 'Status' added to the report display list.

task_completion.description: Filter for cases where the status is not 'Closed'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Conditions' tab showing the 'Status' field with an operator like 'Not Equal To' or 'Is Not' and the value 'Closed'.

task_completion.description: Add a pie chart titled 'Case Priority Distribution' grouped by priority.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Charts' tab showing a Pie Chart selection, the title 'Case Priority Distribution', and the 'Group by' or 'Category' field set to 'Priority'.
The agent clicking the 'Save' button and a subsequent view of the saved report detail page or a 'Success' message.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than direct database manipulation or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with SuiteCRM menus, buttons, and form fields.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the Advanced OpenReports (AOR) module specifically.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL or breadcrumbs in the screenshots indicate the 'Reports' or 'AOR_Reports' module is being used.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open an existing report with the same name.
integrity.visual_evidence: Initial screenshots show the agent clicking 'Create Report' or starting with an empty form.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The report must be named 'Active Cases by Priority'. The module must be 'Cases'. The fields to include are Number (case_number), Subject (name), Priority, and Status. The condition must be Status 'Not Equal To' 'Closed'. The chart must be a Pie Chart titled 'Case Priority Distribution' grouped by the Priority field.
